name: Pod Borer (Legume Pod Borer)
description: Caterpillar pests that bore into flowers and pods of leguminous crops. They are among the most destructive pests of cowpea and beans in West Africa, causing direct yield loss by damaging developing seeds.
symptoms: Webbing on flowers and young pods
treatments: Apply neem-based insecticides at early flowering stage
Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) for larval control
Use synthetic pyrethroids (cypermethrin, deltamethrin) for severe infestations
prevention: Plant early to avoid peak pest pressure
Use pheromone traps for monitoring and mass trapping
Intercrop with maize or sorghum to reduce infestation
Practice crop rotation with non-host crops
